allowed_dependency_manifest.content: For each fixed integer n greater than 1, define f_n(x) = floor of (n times x) minus the sum for k from 1 to n of (floor of (k times x) divided by k). Determine the set of real x that maximize f_n(x) over all real numbers x, and determine the maximum value of f_n(x).

forbidden_claims.statement_nl: Let $n$ be an integer greater than 1. For which real numbers $x$ is \\[\\lfloor nx \\rfloor - \\sum_{k=1}^{n} \\frac{\\lfloor kx \\rfloor}{k}\\] maximal, and what is the maximal value that this expression can take?

statement_nl: For every integer m with 0 <= m <= n-1, let r_k be the least nonnegative residue of k*m modulo n for k = 1, ..., n. For each integer j with 1 <= j <= n-1, the set S_{m,j} = {k in {1,...,n} : r_k >= j} has cardinality at most n-j.
